<!-- pr-reviewer: ca3ec6d4e1e57bdbec84ef185a22350f0771e7e9 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The full site suite is red. The failures also occur on unchanged upstream/main. This PR does not introduce them.
The review instructions require every test that ran to pass before `merge-ready` can be set.

What looks good:
- I read the complete diff. It covers all five documentation gaps in #3769.
- The five new tests pass. The inventory distinguishes supplied scripts, picker entries, and machine templates.
- The release limits and the Offset warning are explicit.
- No product code, UI code, recorded programs, or goldens change. This is not a SAFETY-tier change.

Local results:
- PR head: `ca3ec6d4e1e57bdbec84ef185a22350f0771e7e9`.
- Base: upstream/main `79d47c28229aaad15a564c82d0214debae0473ef`.
- Trial merge: `511681ade50233704e0f2605da2673ecb0a18150`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge has no conflicts.
- `git diff upstream/main HEAD --check`: passed.
- `ZOLA=/tmp/review-3772-tools/zola python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`: 99 tests ran; six assertion failures in four methods; no errors.
- Zola 0.23.6 passed the checksum from the release workflow. Node v22.22.1 ran the search tests.
- The first attempt lacked Zola. The complete run above replaces that environment result.
- Extra suites run: the four failing methods on an archive of unchanged upstream/main. They reproduce all six assertion failures.
- Cargo gates, Clippy, importer suites, and example catalog suites: not run. The diff contains only site content and Python tests.
- Mutations: not run. No safety code changes. Goldens moved: none.

Requested before merge:
1. `site/tests/test_guide_icons.py:105`: the site lacks `op-multiaxis-deburr.png` and `op-waterjet-profile.png`. The inventory assertion at line 113 also fails. Bring in the site fixes from #3768, then rerun the suite.
2. `site/tests/test_operation_reference.py:59`: the operation reference lacks `WaterjetProfile` and `MultiAxisDeburr`. Bring in the reference fixes from #3768.
3. `site/tests/test_post_processor_reference.py:32`: the reference lacks `onJetOff` and `onJetOn` hook signatures. Bring in the reference fixes from #3768.
4. `site/tests/test_post_processor_reference.py:23`: the manifest reference lacks `lineEnding`, `linearizeArcs`, and `uprightReturn`. Bring in the reference fixes from #3768.

These are existing failures. The fixes can land through #3768 before this PR is checked again. A test run with those fixes in a separate tree does not make this head green.

The PR remains a draft. The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next run.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Missing icons and inventory: added both PNGs. Pin: `GuideIcons.test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app`.
- Missing operation references: added Waterjet Profile and Multi-Axis Deburr sections and pictures. Pin: `OperationReferencePictures.test_every_operation_has_section_and_picture`.
- Missing jet hooks: added `onJetOff()` and `onJetOn()`. Pin: `PostProcessorReference.test_engine_hooks_have_reference_entries`.
- Missing manifest rows: added `lineEnding`, `linearizeArcs`, and `uprightReturn`. Pin: `PostProcessorReference.test_manifest_properties_have_reference_rows`.

Nine separate mutations failed these pins. Each restored fix passed.
The full site suite passes all 99 tests.
The quick gate passes with zero selected Rust steps.
The example catalog passes 39 tests; four tests are ignored.
No Rust crate changes. Clippy and heavy lanes do not apply.

New head: `274cbb11aad5ffb318946d26171aa7f1f25bc7d6`.
Please review this head again.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 274cbb11aad5ffb318946d26171aa7f1f25bc7d6 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a second review. The earlier review read head `ca3ec6d4e`. This review reads the fix commit `274cbb11a` and the complete diff again.

Earlier findings:
1. `site/tests/test_guide_icons.py:105`, missing icons and inventory: fixed. Commit `274cbb11a` adds `op-multiaxis-deburr.png` and `op-waterjet-profile.png`. `cmp` shows that each file is equal to its file in `assets/ui/`. `GuideIcons.test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app` passes.
2. `site/tests/test_operation_reference.py:59`, missing operation references: fixed. The commit adds the Waterjet Profile page, the Multi-Axis Deburr section and the two diagrams. `OperationReferencePictures.test_every_operation_has_section_and_picture` passes.
3. `site/tests/test_post_processor_reference.py:32`, missing jet hooks: fixed. The reference has `onJetOn()` and `onJetOff()`. `PostProcessorReference.test_engine_hooks_have_reference_entries` passes.
4. `site/tests/test_post_processor_reference.py:23`, missing manifest rows: fixed. The reference has `lineEnding`, `linearizeArcs` and `uprightReturn`. `PostProcessorReference.test_manifest_properties_have_reference_rows` passes.

What looks good:
- The diff changes only `site/` content, static assets and Python tests. This is not a SAFETY-tier change.
- I compared the new guide text with the code. The quoted refusals agree with `waterjet_op.rs:56`, `waterjet_op.rs:68`, `waterjet/mod.rs:111`, `waterjet/mod.rs:114`, `waterjet/emit.rs:61`, `multiaxis_deburr_op.rs:44` and `cnc_jet.rs:164`.
- The Multi-Axis Deburr defaults agree with `multiaxis_deburr_op.rs`. The manifest rows agree with `line_ending.rs`, `program_bounds.rs` and `upright_after_tilt.rs`.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3769`. The commit subjects are conventional.
- No process file, snapshot PNG, recorded program or golden changes. No app UI code changes, thus screenshots are not necessary.

Results merged with main (locally):
- PR head: `274cbb11aad5ffb318946d26171aa7f1f25bc7d6`.
- Base: upstream/main `436d38ffb`. This main is newer than the base in the PR body.
- Trial merge: `6983c76ab`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge has no conflicts.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 99 tests ran. 96 passed. No assertion failed. Three methods of `test_search_query.SearchQuery` gave an error, because this host has no `node`:

```
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'node'
```

- This error is an environment result, not a defect of the PR. Those three tests read only `site/templates/base.html` and `site/static/vendor/elasticlunr.min.js`. `git diff 79d47c282 HEAD -- site/templates site/static/vendor site/tests/test_search_query.py` is empty. The earlier review ran the same tests on those same files with Node v22.22.1, and they passed.
- The Zola build tests passed with the Zola from Homebrew. The build checks the new internal links.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: "nothing in crates/ changed: no tests to run"; 0 steps.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed.
- Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code.
- Example catalog, Clippy and heavy lanes: not run. The diff changes no post, operation, motion, catalog or Rust file. No heavy lane is reached.
- Mutations: not run. No safety code changes. Goldens moved: none.

Requested before merge: none.

Optional, non-blocking:
- `site/tests/test_guide_icons.py:97`, `site/tests/test_post_processor_reference.py:19` and `:30` add fixed names to sets that the tests already derive from the source. The lines are not necessary, but they do no harm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merging as SAME (no head movement since the counted review). The review that stands: `<!-- pr-reviewer: 274cbb11aad5ffb318946d26171aa7f1f25bc7d6 -->` by mkinney, clean at head `274cbb11aad5ffb318946d26171aa7f1f25bc7d6`. Merge commit pinned with `--match-head-commit`.
